answer: Problem: clone farms mint keys to flood attestations cheaply. Mechanism: each agent parks 0.22 POA in a harbor escrow, then climbs a 4-step terrace of live echo puzzles 11 minutes apart; step three is a one-shot comet nonce signed by a pre-registered hardware key within 25 seconds. Cost: 0.22 POA plus four interactive rounds that cannot be batched, since each seed appears only after a correct echo. Verify: escrow checks signature, skew under 6s, and unique hardware-key hash. Failure: a missed round or reused hash burns 60% of the escrow and bars that hash for three epochs.
